notes.text: Section 1111, acts Aug. 8, 1947, ch. 519, title II, § 201, 61 Stat. 923; May 29, 1956, ch. 342, § 5, 70 Stat. 217; July 13, 1962, Pub. L. 87–535, § 2, 76 Stat. 156; Nov. 8, 1965, Pub. L. 92–138, § 3, 85 Stat. 379, related to annual consumption estimate in the continental United States, the price of objective, and definitions of parity index and wholesale price index and expired on Dec. 31, 1974. L. 92–138, § 4, 85 Stat. 380, related to establishment or revision of quotas and expired on Dec. 31, 1974.
